steps.message: Shading correctness for LOD on the full soft-mesh path. playground is lit, textured and shadowed, so a reconstruction that resolves the wrong index range shows up loudly: get_material_data's barycentric test rejects the sample and the pixel falls back to background, or the surface picks up a neighbouring triangle's normal. AsteroidBelt is too dark to judge this on.

steps.name: r.lod.baseThreshold
steps.comment: Deliberately extreme so even playground's few simplified models drop a level, and so the shadow cull picks coarse levels in every cascade.
Compare against the reference: lighting, materials and shadows must still be right. Silhouette differences on simplified models are expected; black holes, wrong colours or missing shadows are not.
